topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Ran into Jimmy today, or at least, who I thought was Jimmy. We grew up together, the kind of friends who shared secrets while staring up at the stars, planning to change the world. Met him outside the old candy store, now some fancy coffee joint. „Jimmy!“ I shouted, already extending my hand, but he just looked at me with this blank stare. „Sorry, you must have me mistaken for someone else,“ he says, all polite and distant. I must’ve looked pretty stunned, ’cause he gave me this sympathetic smile and walked off. Must be a mistake. People don’t just forget their best friends, do they?
